verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents first-party bulk operations. Patch-by-filter and delete-by-filter modify or remove every document matching a filter, and column-based upserts write many rows in a single request. Server-side namespace copies, copy-on-write branching and async (`Prefer: respond-async`) execution cover long-running bulk jobs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk operations at scale, documented batch-size limits and per-item error handling.
